name: Baked Eggplant Parmigiana
ingredients: 1 large eggplant (about 400 g), cut in 1 cm slices
2 tbsp besan mixed with 3 tbsp water (egg-free binder)
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dip the eggplant slices in the besan mixture, then breadcrumbs, and arrange on a lined tray. Bake for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Heat the oil and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the passata, beans and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes. Season.
Spoon a layer of sauce into a baking dish, add half the eggplant, then more sauce; repeat.
Top with the mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes until bubbling.
note: The besan binder keeps it egg-free; the white beans in the sauce add protein and fibre.
